title: Completion of a strict henselization is Noetherian and faithfully flat
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, let $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples], and let $\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}=\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be the maximal ideal of $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$. Let $\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}=\varprojlim_n R^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}})^n$ be the completion at this ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then $\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}$ is Noetherian and the canonical local map $R^{\mathrm{sh}}\to\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].
